title: Cloud City: Compliance, Governance & Assured Workloads
city_concept: City Public Health Inspections & Guild Charters

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Taverns and bakeries were operating with dirty water and spoiled grain, claiming that because the city paved the street outside, food was safe.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Chief Inspector Ines instituted the Shared Municipal Charter: the city guarantees clean water to the curb, but tavern keepers must cook food to 100 degrees.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: During a surprise inspection, Ines shut down a brewery that failed to maintain temperature logs, protecting public health.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: City health audits happen once a year; cloud compliance guardrails (Policy as Code) enforce rules continuously on every API call.
